**No—the 2025 loss is not yet confirmed as persistent.** Hansen data mapped a candidate tree-cover loss of approximately 13.5 hectares, or 3.91% of the property.

The JRC map indicates that 98% of the affected area was forest in 2020, but that establishes the prior forest cover, not persistence of the loss. Because 2025 is the latest year observed, a later year is needed for corroboration. The assessment remains **pending corroboration**.

The evidence also does not establish the cause of the loss or whether it was deforestation.
